name: com.piqline/open
title: Piqline (open door)
description: No key: what Piqline can do for a business, and its openly published data. Read-only.

tools.name: piqline_for
tools.description: Says what Piqline (a monitoring platform that reads any public source, dates what it sees and alerts teams) can do for a given business: six concrete uses ranked by value (new clients, hiring, competitors, content…), the technologies behind each, and first requests to try. Give a profession, a company, a website (its public pages are read) or a use case. Describes how Piqline works for that business; it returns no live data. Answers in French by default.

about.description: A profession, a company, a website (example.com) or a use case, in a few words.

tools.name: piqline_ask
tools.description: Asks Piqline's guest agent a question, no account and no key. It answers only from what Piqline publishes openly: the weekly advertising 'temperature' of French niches (active advertisers, newcomers, leavers), the 'who said it first' timelines already published, the professions it has pages for, its technologies, and the public home page of a website you name. It never sees any workspace or private data and cannot start a collection. Answers cite their source page and date. Limited per day; when the door is closed it says so. For a watch of your own and the full tools, create a free account; the structured result gives the links (getStarted).

question.description: A question about Piqline's public data or about what Piqline can do.

tools.name: piqline_professions
tools.description: Lists the professions that have a dedicated Piqline page (French, English or German), optionally filtered by a few words. No cost, no model.

query.description: A few words, e.g. 'real estate' or 'creator'.

language.description: Language of the list. Default: fr.

tools.name: piqline_capabilities
tools.description: The five pillars of Piqline and every technology in production under each: accessing any public source, extracting, understanding, acting, delivering.
